课程简介（中文）

本课程旨在系统介绍卫生体系的分析框架与国际比较。主要内容包括：

  1. 分析框架构建：讲解多种用于理解卫生体系的理论分析框架，辨析不同框架的异同与适用情境。

  2. 经典模式剖析：聚焦五大发达经济体的医疗卫生体系模式——英国的国家卫生服务模式、加拿大的国家医疗保险模式、德国的社会医疗保险模式、新加坡的医疗储蓄账户模式，以及美国的商业医疗保险主导模式。

  3. 框架应用与评估：运用卫生体系分析框架，深入比较上述模式在医疗服务可及性、运行效率、服务质量、健康结果、财务风险保护、公众满意度及医疗费用控制等方面的表现。

  4. 挑战与创新探索：分析中低收入国家在卫生筹资等领域面临的核心挑战，并探讨其在转向以初级卫生保健为核心的整合型医疗卫生体系过程中的最新改革实践，特别结合“健康中国2030”的宏观背景进行讨论。

课程简介（英文）

  • Introduce several analytical frameworks for conceptualizing health systems and their similarities and differences.
  • Introduce five generic models of health care systems among advanced economies—National Health Service (UK), National Health Insurance (Canada), Social Health Insurance (Germany), Medical Savings Accounts (Singapore) and Private Health Insurance (US system).
  • Use the health system framework to analyze how the different systems perform in access to care, efficiency, quality, health outcome, financial risk protection, public satisfaction and health expenditure control.
  • Analyze the challenges that low- and middle-income countries (LMIC) face in health care financing and introduce some recent innovations in transformation towards primary care-led integrated healthcare system, especially in the context of “Healthy China 2030”.

教学目标

  • To understand the key structural elements of a health system and how they determine the system performance
  • To be familiar with the five generic models of health system of advanced economies
  • To learn how to assess the performances of health systems
  • To understand the unique challenges that health systems in low- and middle-income countries are facing, especially in China
  • To understand the goals of “Healthy China” and measures to achieve them
  • To be introduced to recent innovations in transformation towards primary care-led integrated healthcare system

教学方式

Lecture, discussion and presentation
